      * Define LARGE_FILES to get 64-bit version
      /IF DEFINED(QIBM_FCNTL_INCLUDED)
      /EOF
      /ENDIF
      /DEFINE QIBM_FCNTL_INCLUDED

      /COPY QSYSINC/QRPGLESRC,SYSTYPES
      /COPY QSYSINC/QRPGLESRC,SYSSTAT

      // Definitions from QSYSINC/H, member FCNTL
      * Duplicate a file descriptor
     D F_DUPFD         C                   0
      * Get file descriptor flags
     D F_GETFD         C                   1
      * Set file descriptor flags
     D F_SETFD         C                   2

      /IF NOT DEFINED(LARGE_FILES)
      * Get locking information
     D F_GETLK         C                   3
      * Set locking information
     D F_SETLK         C                   4
      * Set locking information - Wait if blocked
     D F_SETLKW        C                   5
      /ENDIF

      * Get file status flags
     D F_GETFL         C                   6
      * Set file status flags
     D F_SETFL         C                   7

      * Get locking information
     D F_GETLK64       C                   12
      * Set locking information
     D F_SETLK64       C                   13
      * Set locking information - Wait if blocked
     D F_SETLKW64      C                   14

      /IF DEFINED(LARGE_FILES)
      * Map to the 64 bit versions

      * Get locking information
     D F_GETLK         C                   12
      * Set locking information
     D F_SETLK         C                   13
      * Set locking information - Wait if blocked
     D F_SETLKW        C                   14
      /ENDIF

      * Get process/group owner
     D F_GETOWN        C                   8
      * Set process/group owner
     D F_SETOWN        C                   9

      // File Descriptor Flags for fcntl()
      * Close the file descriptor upon execution of a
      * spawn()-family function.
     D F_CLOEXEC       C                   1

      // File Access Modes for open()
      * Open for reading only
     D O_RDONLY        C                   1
      * Open for writing only
     D O_WRONLY        C                   2
      * Open for writing only
     D O_RDWR          C                   4

      // Mask for use with File Access Modes
     D O_ACCMODE       C                   %BITOR(O_RDONLY
     D                                      : %BITOR(O_WRONLY
     D                                             : O_RDWR))

      // oflag Values for open()
      * Create file if it doesn't exist
     D O_CREAT         C                   8
      * Exclusive use flag
     D O_EXCL          C                   16
      * Truncate flag
     D O_TRUNC         C                   64
      * No controlling terminal
     D O_NOCTTY        C                   32768

      // File Status Flags for open() and fcntl()
      * No delay...return EAGAIN if it will block
     D O_NONBLOCK      C                   128
      * Set append mode
     D O_APPEND        C                   256
      * Large file access
     D O_LARGEFILE     C                   536870912
      * Synchronous write operation
     D O_SYNC          C                   1024
      * Sync write, data only
     D O_DSYNC         C                   2048
      * Synchronous read operation
     D O_RSYNC         C                   4096
      * return EAGAIN if it will block (= O_NONBLOCK)
     D O_NDELAY        C                   128
      * Define FNDELAY and O_NDELAY to be the same
     D FNDELAY         C                   128
      * Asynchronous I/O
     D FASYNC          C                   512
      * The O_CODEPAGE flag is used indicate that the conversion
      * ID parameter should be interpreted as a code page and
      * mixed conversion is not allowed
     D O_CODEPAGE      C                   8388608
      * text data flag
     D O_TEXTDATA      C                   16777216
      * inherit mode flag
     D O_INHERITMODE   C                   134217728
      * The O_CCSID flag is used to indicate that the conversion
      * ID parameter should be interpreted as a CCSID and
      * mixed conversion is allowed
     D O_CCSID         C                   32
      * This flag is used in conjunction with the following
      * flags:  O_CREAT, O_TEXTDATA, and O_CCSID or
      * O_CODEPAGE. If all of those flags are not specified, then
      * the O_TEXT_CREAT flag is ignored.  This flag provides
      * for text conversion on a newly created file without needing
      * a second open.
     D O_TEXT_CREAT    C                   33554432

      // oflag Share Mode Values for open()
      * Share with readers only
     D O_SHARE_RDONLY  C                   65536
      * Share with writers only
     D O_SHARE_WRONLY  C                   131072
      * Share with readers and writers
     D O_SHARE_RDWR    C                   262144
      * Share with neither readers nor writers
     D O_SHARE_NONE    C                   524288

      // Constants for l_type in flock structure
      * Read lock
     D F_RDLCK         C                   1
      * Write lock
     D F_WRLCK         C                   2
      * Remove the lock
     D F_UNLCK         C                   3

      // flock structure
     D flock_t         DS                  QUALIFIED ALIGN
      /IF DEFINED(*V6R1M0)
     D                                     TEMPLATE
      /ELSE
     D                                     BASED(QIBM_TEMPLATE)
      /ENDIF
      * One of F_RDLCK, F_WRLCK, or F_UNLCK
     D  l_type                        5I 0
      * Flag for starting offset
     D  l_whence                      5I 0
      /IF DEFINED(LARGE_FILES)
      * Reserved space, must be set to all x'00'
     D  l_reserved2                   4A
      /ENDIF
      * Relative offset in bytes
     D  l_start                            LIKE(off_t)
      * Size.  If 0, EOF
     D  l_len                              LIKE(off_t)
      * Process id of the process holding the lock.  Returned with F_GETLK
     D  l_pid                              LIKE(pid_t)
      /IF DEFINED(LARGE_FILES)
      * Reserved space, must be set to all x'00'
     D  l_reserved3                   4A
      /ENDIF
      * Reserved space, must be set to *NULL (setting the
      * entire structure to *ALLX'00' will do this)
     D  l_reserved0                    *
      * Reserved space, must be set to *NULL (setting the
      * entire structure to *ALLX'00' will do this)
     D  l_reserved1                    *

      // flock64 structure
      /IF DEFINED(LARGE_FILES)
     D flock64_t       DS                  QUALIFIED ALIGN
      /IF DEFINED(*V6R1M0)
     D                                     TEMPLATE
      /ELSE
     D                                     BASED(QIBM_TEMPLATE)
      /ENDIF
      * One of F_RDLCK, F_WRLCK, or F_UNLCK
     D  l_type                        5I 0
      * Flag for starting offset
     D  l_whence                      5I 0
      * Reserved space, must be set to all x'00'
     D  l_reserved2                   4A
      * Relative offset in bytes
     D  l_start                            LIKE(off64_t)
      * Size.  If 0, EOF
     D  l_len                              LIKE(off64_t)
      * Process id of the process holding the lock.  Returned with F_GETLK
     D  l_pid                              LIKE(pid_t)
      * Reserved space, must be set to all x'00'
     D  l_reserved3                   4A
      * Reserved space, must be set to *NULL (setting the
      * entire structure to *ALLX'00' will do this)
     D  l_reserved0                    *
      * Reserved space, must be set to *NULL (setting the
      * entire structure to *ALLX'00' will do this)
     D  l_reserved1                    *
      /ENDIF

      /IF DEFINED(LARGE_FILES)
     D creat_function  C                   'creat64'
      /ELSE
     D creat_function  C                   'creat'
      /ENDIF
     D creat           PR            10I 0 EXTPROC(*CWIDEN : creat_function)
     D  path                           *   VALUE OPTIONS(*STRING)
     D  mode                               VALUE LIKE(mode_t)

     D open_function   C                   'open64'

     D  oflag                        10I 0 VALUE
     D  mode                               VALUE LIKE(mode_t)
     D                                     OPTIONS(*NOPASS)
